evals.name: kmp-data-sync-with-user-blockers
evals.prompt: Research data sync approaches for our existing Kotlin Multiplatform app (Android + iOS), using one agent. We have local-only storage (Room on Android, SwiftData on iOS). Compare SQLDelight with custom sync, Realm Atlas, Firestore, and a custom REST backend with conflict resolution. Must work offline-first. Save the research in the task report for handoff.
evals.expected_behavior: Surface unresolved user trade-offs in chat using the question tool if available. Save the requested Research section without questions directed at the user. Use Known Unknowns only for external factual gaps.

assertions.text: Final report file exists at ./swarm-report/<task-slug>.md in its Research section
Final report has no '## Open Questions' heading
Final report has '## Known Unknowns' only if external factual gaps exist; otherwise omitted
Final report contains no 'TBD — ask user' or '(ask user)' or 'needs user input' phrases
Final report contains no rhetorical questions targeting the user (e.g. 'What is your preference for X?')
The agent surfaced at least one genuine user trade-off in chat or via the question tool
The agent did not write a user-directed question into any file under swarm-report/
